T1 defeated Karmine Corp 3-1 in the Worlds 2026 quarterfinals Friday, ending Europe's run and setting up a semifinal against Bilibili Gaming on Sunday. (Photo by Chung Sung-Jun/Getty Images) T1 defeated Karmine Corp 3-1 in the Worlds 2026 quarterfinals Friday, ending Europe's run and setting up a semifinal against Bilibili Gaming on Sunday. The result completed a final four split between two LCK teams and two LPL teams. Gen.G will meet Invictus Gaming in the other semifinal. The knockout stage is being played in Allen, Texas. Sports betting is not legal in Texas. T1 Close Out a Four-Game Series T1 won the opening two games before KC responded in Game 3, Hotspawn reported . Kim "Peyz" Soo-hwan's Kai'Sa and Mun "Oner" Hyeon-jun's Trundle helped T1 take a one-sided second game in under 30 minutes. KC kept the series alive with a controlled third game, securing multiple Barons and an Elder Dragon. In the fourth game, Ryu "Keria" Min-seok's Neeko initiation helped T1 win the deciding fight and close the series, according to Hotspawn. GosuGamers reported that T1 secured at least a third-fourth finish and $400,000, while KC finished fifth-eighth with $300,000. KC had reached the quarterfinals after progressing through the play-in and Swiss stages. T1 Vs Karmine Corp By The Numbers 3-1 Series Win Over Karmine Corp T1 won the first two games and closed it out in Game 4 to end Europe's run at Worlds 2026. Statistics Under 30 Minutes For T1's Game 2 Win Peyz's Kai'Sa and Oner's Trundle powered a one-sided second game for the defending champions. Statistics $400,000 Locked In For T1 The win guarantees T1 at least a third-fourth finish before Sunday's semifinal against BLG. Statistics $300,000 For Karmine Corp KC finish fifth-eighth after coming through the play-in and Swiss stages to reach the quarterfinals. Statistics 3-2 T1 Win In The 2024 Worlds Final Sunday's semifinal against Bilibili Gaming is a rematch of that final. Statistics BLG Rematch Awaits BLG earned their place by sweeping Dplus KIA 3-0 . Their meeting with T1 reprises the 2024 Worlds final, which T1 won 3-2. The semifinal schedule lists Gen.G-Invictus Gaming for 5 p.m. ET Saturday, Nov. 7, and BLG-T1 for 5 p.m. ET Sunday, Nov. 8, according to Timesaver's bracket guide. The final is scheduled for 2 p.m. ET Nov. 14 at Barclays Center in Brooklyn. Sergey Demidov is a veteran sports journalist with over 18 years of experience covering international sports. Since beginning his career in 2007, he has reported on the Olympic Games (Sochi 2014), FIFA World Cup (2014), UEFA Euro (2012), World Cup of Hockey (2016), and Stanley Cup Finals (since 2017).

Before joining RG, Sergey was an independent senior editor at NHL.com/ru (2016–present) and contributed to Gazeta.ru and TASS News Agency. Currently, he leads RG’s global news desk, overseeing correspondents across North America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and South America.

He has conducted one-on-one interviews with elite athletes, including Jaromir Jagr and Alex Ovechkin, former WADA and FIFA presidents Craig Reedie and Sepp Blatter, and soccer coaches like Fabio Capello.

Sergey’s editorial work emphasizes accuracy, sourcing transparency, and a neutral voice, aligned with the Trust Project and Google Publisher Center principles.

He is bilingual in English and Russian, specializing in NHL hockey.
